title: Voyager PROV Record
description: Input shape to voyager-prov-* emit(). v0 draft against a Voyager-internal register namespace; swap the activityType pattern once D110 URIs freeze.

activity_type.description: Voyager pipeline activity type. Layer 2 (RAG): connect/extract/chunk/embed/retrieve/generate. Layer 1 (HQ-side FAS enrichment): geotag/classify-commodity/classify-region/nlp-extract-entities/ocr/field-normalize.

agent.description: URI of the agent (connector, service, model) that ran the activity.

used.description: Entity URIs the activity consumed. Order-insensitive; emit() sorts before hashing identity.

generated.description: Entity URIs the activity produced. Order-insensitive; emit() sorts before hashing identity.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC or ±HH:MM offset. Millisecond precision optional.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC or ±HH:MM offset. Must be >= started_at.

extra.description: Provenance-relevant metadata not part of the activity identity.
